senses: the 1st son of Hezron, grandson of Pharez, and great grandson of Judah and the founder of the family of Jerahmeelites
officer sent by king Jehoiakim of Judah to arrest Baruch
a Merarite Levite the representative of the family of Kish, the son of Mahli

strongs.def: Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites
strongs.from: from H7355 (רָחַם) and H410 (אֵל); God will compassionate
